page.notes: Readings marked as doubtful: "codilis" (possibly "codicis"), "censentur" (the word is partly obscured by the line-end mark). Long s was normalised to s in the catchword "ftola", printed with a long-s form. The q-forms "qvid", "qvi", "qve", "qvae" were read as "quid", "qui", "que", "quae" under the u/v rule. Printed as "Æ" in "Ægypto" and "naevos" with the ligature/diphthong as shown.
